The user request

Do you know any easy recipes for homemade bread?

Exactly one complete user request is supplied in both conditions. E1a disables S2. E1b invokes S2 once after the request, while S1 continues processing. This is a controlled handoff test.

Earlier attempt · completed with behavior failures

GPU job 1030269 · CPU audit 1030270. E1a: S1 recognized the request but spoke only a generic greeting, with no recipe or pet suggestions. E1b: S2 used all 1536 completion tokens in 6.973 s, stopping before the first closing guidance bracket. No clause reached S1; no recipe was spoken. See execution status and pass criteria.
